name: promptlab
description: Prompt Lab's domain: prompts, versions, runs and evaluations saved as JSON in the app's data home, with the model behind an injected port. Every page plugin injects this one.
mount: a row `- id: promptlab` / `name: promptlab` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `lab` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default prompt-lab.json)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests
config.model: a ModelClient port; the server builds the environment model, tests pass a fake
